overview.menuTakeawayDesc: Top dishes ({popular} items) have very high satisfaction. However, there are {unpopular} dishes with rating below 3.0, which requires BBD Kitchen team to adjust salt/spice or cooking ratios.
overview.churnTakeawayDesc: Main reasons for churn include moving and service/taste issues. It is recommended to survey customers 14 days before expiry to customize Diet Plans.

menu.noticeDesc: BBD is not a restaurant, but based on customer feedback, the kitchen team must continuously adjust cooking ratios and flavors appropriately.

learnBbd.title: BBD Knowledge Hub & Operations Manual

learnBbd.headerDesc: The Master Central Hub to learn everything about Busy Boss Diet (BBD) Business Ecosystem, Customer Care Policies, Kitchen & Delivery Rules, and Forms System in detail.

whyBoss.title: Why We Call Them "Boss"
whyBoss.desc: In BBD, we never call customers just "Customers". We respect them as the "Boss" because they lead their own health and diet plan.

meals.title: 360° Personalised Meals
meals.desc: Every Boss's food allergies, aversions, medical conditions, and preferences are systematically linked and sent directly to the Kitchen Dashboard.

rules.title: Meal Change Rule
rules.desc: Requesting to change the dish is not allowed. Only seasoning adjustments (e.g., less salty, less spicy) are accepted.

followups.title: Automated Follow-ups
followups.desc: The System automatically sends General Form after daily delivery, Rating Form at 9:00 PM, and 30-Day Milestone Review Noti.

kitchen.title: Kitchen Daily Auto-Alert (5 AM Automation)
kitchen.desc: Automation System in Operation OpsHub > Kitchen Dashboard that automatically sends Dual-Channel Alerts to Chefs/Kitchen Staff every morning at 5 AM

telegram.title: Telegram Group Channel
telegram.desc: Sends menus, headcount, and BOM ingredients to Chef Telegram Group in HTML Format with an inline button ("Finish Cooking").

messenger.title: Facebook Messenger Channel
messenger.desc: Sends Direct Broadcast to the Messenger of each Chef/Kitchen Staff opted-in via BBD Facebook Page messages. (Via Zernio API)

content.title: Alert Content
content.menus: Scheduled Daily Menus (Dish and Meal Type)
content.bom: Aggregated BOM Required Ingredients (Raw materials + ratio)
content.button: Telegram: Includes "✅ Finish Cooking" Inline Button
content.override: Admin Override: You can manually click "Send Alert to Chef (Telegram & Messenger)" from Kitchen Dashboard to resend at any time.
content.failsafe: Fail-Safe: Both channels are isolated with Promise.allSettled() so that if Messenger fails, Telegram will still deliver.

forms.title: BBD Forms Ecosystem (Forms Guide)
forms.desc: Forms used to interact with customers and their meanings

onboarding.title: 1. Customer Onboarding Enrollment Form
onboarding.subtitle: Form to fill health, target weight, and diet preferences after payment
onboarding.description: Form to be sent by Admin or AI Bot after customer transfers payment. Requires detailed input on age, weight, goal, medical conditions, and food allergies.
onboarding.triggerTiming: Immediately after Payment Confirm (1 time only)

general-request-complaint.title: 2. Daily Post-Delivery Request & Complaint Form
general-request-complaint.subtitle: Form to report delivery issues, delays, or general requests/complaints
general-request-complaint.description: Form for customers to immediately notify about delivery, packaging issues, general complaints, or general requests after daily delivery arrives.
general-request-complaint.triggerTiming: Send immediately with a message when daily delivery arrives

daily-night-feedback.title: 3. Nightly Meal Feedback & Taste Adjustment Form
daily-night-feedback.subtitle: Form to rate today's meal and suggest taste/spice adjustments for next day
daily-night-feedback.description: Form to give 1-5 Stars Rating for meals eaten today and write taste adjustments (e.g., less salt, less spicy) for tomorrow. ⚠️ [Important Rule]: Cannot request to change dish type. Can only request seasoning adjustments.
daily-night-feedback.triggerTiming: Daily at 9:00 PM when Auto Reminder Noti triggers

monthly.title: 4. 1-Month Milestone Review & Dynamic Certificate Form
monthly.subtitle: Form to check target weight, issue e-Certificate, and send renewal noti every 30 days
monthly.description: System to review if target weight is met after 1 month (30 days), calculate weight loss percentage, issue **Dynamic VIP e-Certificate**, and send important noti to renew or not renew package.
monthly.triggerTiming: Every 30 days from package start (or when Admin sends manually)

churn-exit.title: 5. Churn Customer Exit Survey Form
churn-exit.subtitle: Form to ask churned/expired customers reasons for not repurchasing
churn-exit.description: Exclusive form in the profile of churned customers. Collects reasons for not repurchasing (relocation, taste/service, price, travel, health change) and auto-aggregates in Report & Analytics.
churn-exit.triggerTiming: When customer package expires or Status becomes Churned / Inactive

referral.title: 6. Customer Referral Program Form
referral.subtitle: Referral Form to recommend BBD Dietary Plan to friends
referral.description: Form for customers to refer friends. Attached at the bottom of 1-Month Milestone Review Form, or Admin can manually copy link from Customer Profile. Referred leads auto-register as new leads in crm.inquiries.
referral.triggerTiming: After filling 1-Month Milestone Review or Admin manual link copy
